preconditions.description: A and B must be non-negative integers representing total beer limits for Mike and Joe, respectively.

postconditions.description: If either Mike (A < 1) or Joe (B < 1) cannot drink at least 1 beer, return 'Non-drinkers can't play'.

postconditions.expression: A >= 1 and B >= 1 and (return_value == 'Mike' or return_value == 'Joe')
postconditions.description: If both can drink at least 1 beer, return 'Mike' if Mike wins the game, otherwise return 'Joe'.

postconditions.expression: A >= 1 and B >= 1 and return_value == 'Mike' and all(A >= sum(2 * i - 1 for i in range(1, k + 1)) and B >= sum(2 * i for i in range(1, k)) for k in range(1, 1000)) and A < sum(2 * (k + 1) - 1 for i in range(1, k + 1))
postconditions.description: Mike wins if he can complete all his turns (odd-numbered turns) without exceeding his limit A, and Joe cannot complete his next turn (even-numbered turn) without exceeding his limit B.

postconditions.expression: A >= 1 and B >= 1 and return_value == 'Joe' and all(A >= sum(2 * i - 1 for i in range(1, k + 1)) and B >= sum(2 * i for i in range(1, k + 1)) for k in range(1, 1000)) and B >= sum(2 * (k + 1))
postconditions.description: Joe wins if both can complete all their turns up to some round k without exceeding their limits, and Joe can complete his (k+1)-th turn without exceeding his limit B, while Mike cannot complete his (k+1)-th turn without exceeding his limit A.
